title: Quality profile size editor caps sizes at 400 MiB/min while the API allows 1000
body:
### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [x] I have searched the existing open and closed issues

### Current Behavior

The size editor in Edit Quality Profile won't accept sizes above 400 MiB/min, while the API accepts up to 1000, the same limit as the v4 quality definitions page. A quality with no maximum set is shown as 400 "Unlimited".

Sizes above 400 saved through the API display correctly (e.g. 0 / 567 / 729), but typing a higher value such as 750 into Maximum snaps it to 400.

### Expected Behavior

The size editor accepts the same range as the API, 0 to 1000 MiB/min, so sizes above 400 can be set and changed from the UI.

### Steps To Reproduce

1. Settings > Profiles, edit a profile.
2. Open the Sizes tab.
3. Type 750 into any quality's Maximum.
4. Maximum snaps to 400.

### Environment

```markdown
- OS: Unraid
- Sonarr: 5.0.0.2569
- Docker Install: Yes (lscr.io/linuxserver/sonarr:develop-5.0.0.2569-ls193)
- Using Reverse Proxy: Yes (Traefik)
- Browser: Firefox 157.0.1 on Windows 11
- Database: SQLite
```

### What branch are you running?

Develop

### Trace Logs

UI only. The browser console shows no errors while typing into the size inputs. Full console output:

[signalR] Information: Connection disconnected.
[signalR] Information: Connection reconnecting.
[signalR] Information: Reconnect attempt number 1 will start in 0 ms.
[signalR] starting
[signalR] Information: Normalizing '/signalr/messages?access_token=(removed)' to 'http://sonarr-v5.orion/signalr/messages?access_token=(removed)'.
[signalR] Information: WebSocket connected to ws://sonarr-v5.orion/signalr/messages?access_token=(removed)&id=TV2tIg_XEgVyuKxd-i1rtA.
[signalR] Information: Using HubProtocol 'json'.
[signalR] connected
[signalR] received version { version: "5.0.0.2569" }

### Anything else

The editor's limit is [`const MAX = 400`](https://github.com/Sonarr/Sonarr/blob/4831dfe91cdceaeba3d441abb3d348c4c53b605a/frontend/src/Settings/Profiles/Quality/QualityProfileItemSize.tsx#L17). The API validates profile sizes against [`QualityDefinitionLimits.Max`](https://github.com/Sonarr/Sonarr/blob/4831dfe91cdceaeba3d441abb3d348c4c53b605a/src/Sonarr.Api.V3/Profiles/Quality/QualityProfileResourceValidator.cs#L33-L38), which is [1000](https://github.com/Sonarr/Sonarr/blob/4831dfe91cdceaeba3d441abb3d348c4c53b605a/src/NzbDrone.Core/Qualities/QualityDefinitionLimits.cs#L6).

The limit was raised from 400 to 1000 for quality definitions in #7084 ([9b144e9](https://github.com/Sonarr/Sonarr/commit/9b144e9adea33fdb6ac7254435655e3d38a2d252)). The per-profile size editor appears to have kept the old value.
